name: @local/vbw-bundle
description: Visual Browser Workspace (VBW) bundle for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1: a host plugin (@local/vbw-host) exposing vbw_* tools that proxy to the local VBW broker, a client-ui plugin (@local/vbw-client-ui) adding a sidebar tab that embeds the broker UI, and 5 vbw-* agent-preset roles. Additive only: no shipped row is overridden.
